rq1.finding: 15 of 28 pairwise schema-completeness source-cluster intervals exclude zero in this finite benchmark; the highest mean was phi-4-mini-instruct (0.275) and the lowest was qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct (0.077). For the reference-fact F1 proxy, 20 of 28 paired intervals exclude zero; its highest mean was llama-3.2-1b-instruct (0.746) and lowest was qwen2.5-3b-instruct (0.190). The measures rank models differently. Treat these as benchmark-specific evidence: only three independent source groups were sampled, and pairwise intervals are unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

rq2.finding: Descriptively, phi-4-mini-instruct had the highest novel-field gain (1.52 per response), qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct had the highest gap-targeting rate (0.53). Redundancy was highest for qwen3-1.7b (0.36) and lowest for llama-3.2-3b-instruct (0.00); several models tied at zero. Turn counts were 4 for every episode, so this run cannot distinguish models by turn count. No single efficiency measure has a prespecified pass threshold.

rq3.finding: Under the amended descriptive quality question, 59.4% of valid ratings were good or excellent. By candidate model the observed range was 39.6% (qwen3-1.7b) to 72.9% (phi-3.5-mini-instruct). This does not answer the original inter-rater reliability question or establish a pass mark.
rq3.amended_question: How frequently were interview follow-up questions rated good or excellent, and how did this vary across candidate models?
rq3.analysis_amendment: This completed-run analysis reframes RQ3 as descriptive judge-assessed quality. It does not answer the original inter-rater reliability question.

interpretation_limits: The full profile evaluates benchmark variants from a small finite proof-of-concept corpus; it is not a representative enterprise sample.
Question variants from one case_group_id are repeated measures, not independent source documents; report the source-group count with all results.
Cluster-bootstrap intervals are based on 3 source groups; with three groups they are coarse and should be interpreted descriptively.
Lexical reference-fact F1 is a proxy and judge-assessed quality does not establish human validity.
RQ2 summaries are descriptive; the thesis does not specify a formal significance test for those outcomes.
The completed-run RQ3 analysis was explicitly reframed from inter-rater reliability to descriptive judge-assessed quality; the original reliability question remains unanswered by this outcome.
